[RCLI.4.1] **[LGRA] is the authoritative statement of the DS language
surface**, and an implementation's parser answers to it rather than the
reverse. Where a compiler's grammar and the `LGRA` productions disagree, the
spec is right and the parser is defective.

No parser is normative over the grammar: every implementation's parser answers
to `[LGRA]`, whatever other parsers exist ([STYL.2.15.5]). An implementation that treats its own grammar as
the definition has inverted the relationship [STYL.2.13] describes — a spec
that sends the reader to the code to learn what it requires.
